Subject: Your consumer complaint matter

Dear Ms. Hegde,

Thank you for meeting us on 12 July 2022 about your dispute with M/s Rao Builders Pvt Ltd. As we understand it, possession of the flat is long overdue.

Our advice is to claim interest on the amount paid for every month of delay in possession. Please collect the allotment letter, the builder-buyer agreement and every payment receipt and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Rohit Wadhwa
